                                                                   EXHIBIT 23.1

                 CONSENT OF INDEPENDENT PUBLIC ACCOUNTANTS



As independent public accountants, we hereby consent to the incorporation by
reference in this Registration Statement (Form 10) of our report dated
February 8, 2001 included in Chicago Merchantile Exchange, Inc.'s Annual
Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2000 and to all
references to our  Firm included in this Registration Statement.






Chicago, Illinois
April 27, 2001
